messages:
shannon: Quick heads-up — published starter-pack v0.1.0 for Community HackWeek. Includes three new templates (chatbot, eval harness, plugin stub), CI presets, and a quickstart guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-pack/releases/tag/v0.1.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: starter-pack v0.1.0 by @shannon — https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-pack/releases/tag/v0.1.0 (auto)
rajesh: Nice! Any breaking changes for folks who used the hackweek preview?
emily: Only one minor rename: starter.yml -> starter.meta.yml and the key `maintainer_contact` -> `contact`. We included a migration helper in scripts/ and the templates accept both keys for two weeks.
shannon: Migration snippet:
```bash
# scripts/migrate-starter.sh
sed -E 's/^maintainer_contact:/contact:/' starter.yml > starter.meta.yml
```
devrel: I'll record a 4-min walkthrough and add the HackWeek session to the community calendar (Mon 9am PT). Also drafting announcement for newsletter and forum.
ops-bot: Note: CI preset `hackweek-fast` added, uses small matrix and skips heavy e2e by default. See .github/workflows/hackweek.yml
rajesh: Can we add a linter to warn on starter.yml to speed migration? I'll open a PR.
open-source-bot: Issue created: #7 "lint: warn on legacy starter.yml key" by @rajesh — https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-pack/issues/7
emily: For private deployers: no infra changes, just templates. Helm chart unchanged. If you rely on generated filenames, update any automation that looks for starter.yml.
shannon: Tagging maintainers for visibility @emily @rajesh @devrel. Soft announce now; broader social tomorrow after we post the walkthrough. If anyone hits migration issues ping #devex. :rocket:
